|game_text=When drawn for destiny, if three Wookiees and/or Ewoks on table, destiny +2. Deploy a bowcaster or Ewok weapon from Lost Pile. OR Take an Ewok or Wookiee of power < 6 into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR During battle at same site as Part Of The Tribe, add one battle destiny.
|errata_history=This is the original printing of “Life Day” in Virtual Modern (version 1 of 2): the card image in place when Virtual Set 23 was officially released (22 July 2024). The current text is [[Life Day (Errata)]] (PC-E1). Each version is the Players Committee's own card image, quoted in full with its upload date; the image on each page is that version's image as published (unchanged). The PC card data (swccg-card-json) is cited as dating evidence only.
* '''Original''' (this page): the card image at official release (20 July 2024)<ref name="ht-335d47f">Players Committee card image, [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/335d47f6b929debedbac9376b863af4442469f36/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual23-Light/large/lifeday.gif as uploaded] to the PC's Holotable image repository (served at [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual23-Light/large/lifeday.gif res.starwarsccg.org]) in commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/335d47f6b929debedbac9376b863af4442469f36 335d47f] “Set 23 new images”, 20 July 2024.</ref> prints: “When drawn for destiny, if three Wookiees and/or Ewoks on table, destiny +2. Deploy a bowcaster or Ewok weapon from Lost Pile. OR Take an Ewok or Wookiee of power < 6 into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR During battle at same site as Part Of The Tribe, add one battle destiny.”<ref name="cj-753083f">Dating evidence only: the PC card data [https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/commit/753083f swccg-card-json commit 753083f] “Set 23” (21 July 2024) first gave the card this wording.</ref> The card image prints no errata mark.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Life Day (Errata)]]): the errata card image (24 July 2024, 3 days after release)<ref name="ht-68ad3ba">Players Committee card image, [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/68ad3bacad81fda51e9730e4dd5e1c0e7b04be54/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual23-Light/large/lifeday.gif as uploaded] to the PC's Holotable image repository (served at [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual23-Light/large/lifeday.gif res.starwarsccg.org]) in commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/68ad3bacad81fda51e9730e4dd5e1c0e7b04be54 68ad3ba] “Life Day proofing fix”, 24 July 2024, 3 days after release.</ref> prints: “When drawn for destiny, if three Ewoks and/or Wookiees on table, destiny +2. OR During battle at same site as Part Of The Tribe, add one battle destiny.” '''What changed:''' In the destiny line, “three Wookiees and/or Ewoks” became “three Ewoks and/or Wookiees” (the two words swapped). No errata mark was printed. The PC card data still gives the original order. The card image prints no errata mark.
